verdicts.reason: The two images look pixel-identical, and both share the same flaws. The left column is a scattered three-column jumble: the LYGOM CAFE logo and gift icons are squeezed into a tiny corner block, www.lygom.se is too small to read, and 'Only this Christmas' floats off to one side.
